title: Nico Lechuga: Bitcoin Will Revolutionize the $4T Private Equity Industry
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Nico Lechuga: Bitcoin Will Revolutionize the $4T Private Equity Industry Traditional PE flips companies on tight deadlines.
